purpose: Public sample-point history and QA, not verified farm observations or rotation recommendations
product: MOD13Q1 ORNL DAAC REST subset; collection version not stated in subset response

points.selection_basis: WorldCover 2021 ranking of 74 complete MODIS grid cells in Klaten sample bbox: 84.469% cropland, 11.727% grassland, 3.803% tree cover, 0% built-up. Derived grid-center coordinate, not GPS field precision or 2026 land-cover confirmation.
WorldCover 2021 center class cropland; actual reported MODIS grid footprint: 69.206% cropland, 19.683% tree cover, 7.619% built-up, 3.492% grassland. Not proof of 2026 land cover or farm boundary.

qa_policy.name: Project conservative selection; QA bit definitions from NASA LAADS MOD13Q1 C6.1 filespec
qa_policy.primary: reliability=0; MODLAND=0; usefulness<=2; aerosol<=1; all cloud/snow/shadow flags=0; pure-land=1; valid NDVI/EVI/date
qa_policy.marginal: reliability in {0,1}; MODLAND<=1; usefulness<=10; aerosol<=2; cloud/snow/shadow flags=0; pure-land=1; valid values, but not primary
qa_policy.excluded: All remaining observations; raw values preserved, never used in monthly means
qa_policy.monthly_assignment: Selected pixel observation date, not composite interval start; no interpolation
qa_policy.threshold_note: Strict usefulness/aerosol thresholds are project choices, not a NASA validated crop recommendation criterion
